text:
sam: rolling canary for aurora-64k-int3 to dedicated-pool-3. saw a repeating suffix on long system prompts when prefilling ~12k tokens. repro attached.
maya: can you show the snippet of the repeat?
sam: after token ~8192 it repeats a short sentence that matches an earlier paragraph. example output: "...the analysis concludes. the analysis concludes. the analysis concludes."
liam: that smells like an index wrap or RoPE phase mismatch. which quant path?
sam: int3 quant path (new packer). int8 path didn't reproduce.
ojas: any difference with async prefetch off?
sam: less frequent but still reproducible slower.
nate: dump kv index and phase table around the boundary, please.
sam: gist with fingerprints: https://gist.github.com/redwood/aurora-kv-fp-1758009876
ci-bot: queued: kvcache-long-repro-1758009876 :gear:
liam: ran deterministic CPU run. saw rollover at 8192 exactly. layer dumps: layer10_kv_index: 8189,8190,8191,0,1,2. but embeddings around rollover look okay. phase table values shifted.
maya: grep shows init_phase_table_shard() in runtime/quant_rope.c invoked during prefill handshake and again on completion -> potential race.
ojas: might be concurrent inits overwriting a shared phase table pointer. fits async prefetch sensitivity.
liam: quick fix: add a mutex around init_phase_table_shard and guard re-init. prepping PR.
maya: also add an assert to detect double-init and emit metric phase_table_version.
sam: checklist: (1) deterministic reproducer (2) log kv-index 8100..8220 per layer (3) bisect earliest token (4) int8 vs int3 comparison.
liam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/9123 (locks around phase table init). estimated 2h.
maya: tested sandbox with PR, 3/3 runs of 14k tokens no repeat. queuing full test.
ci-bot: kvcache-long-repro-1758009876 job started
liam: CI initially failed due to harness pointing at old binary, rerunning with new build.
liam: rerun passed 5/5 deterministic sequences. CI green.
sam: re-rolling canary with PR; monitoring telemetry for phase_table_version and generation ngram deltas.
ojas: add rollout gating check: compare ngram fingerprint pre/post for 5 deterministic prompts; fail rollout on >0.5% ngram overlap regression.
maya: root cause summary for postmortem: race in quantized RoPE phase table init during async prefill handoff. mitigation: locking + telemetry + rollout gating.
sam: thanks everyone. will close after canary stable 24h :tada:
